scenarios.name: Owned account with current review
scenarios.explanation: The active account has an accountable owner and was reviewed within 90 days.

scenarios.name: Active account missing owner
scenarios.explanation: The account is active but lacks an owner, so accountability is missing.
scenarios.matchedClause: deny contains msg if active and not owner

scenarios.name: Authenticated role with allowed action
scenarios.explanation: The caller is authenticated, the role is approved, and the action is in policy.

scenarios.name: Authenticated caller with unapproved role
scenarios.explanation: Authentication alone is insufficient when the role is not authorized for the resource.
scenarios.matchedClause: deny contains msg if role not approved

scenarios.name: Logging enabled with retention and alerting
scenarios.explanation: Logs are collected, retained beyond the minimum, and connected to alerting.

scenarios.name: Logging disabled for critical source
scenarios.explanation: Retention and alerting do not compensate for disabled log collection.
scenarios.matchedClause: deny contains msg if logging disabled

scenarios.name: Asset matches approved baseline
scenarios.explanation: The asset has an approved baseline and no detected configuration drift.

scenarios.name: Asset has unapproved drift
scenarios.explanation: Detected drift must be remediated or covered by an approved exception.
scenarios.matchedClause: deny contains msg if unapproved drift

scenarios.name: Unique identity with MFA and bound session
scenarios.explanation: The user authenticated as a unique identity with MFA and a bound session.

scenarios.name: Unique identity without MFA
scenarios.explanation: Organizational users must satisfy multi-factor authentication.
scenarios.matchedClause: deny contains msg if mfa not satisfied

scenarios.name: Managed interface with approved logged flow
scenarios.explanation: The flow crosses a managed default-deny boundary, is approved, and is logged.

scenarios.name: Managed interface with unapproved flow
scenarios.explanation: Logging alone does not authorize an unapproved communication flow.
scenarios.matchedClause: deny contains msg if flow not approved

scenarios.name: Defined events generate complete records
scenarios.explanation: Auditable events are defined and produce investigation-ready audit records.

scenarios.name: Records generated with incomplete content
scenarios.explanation: Generated records still fail when required investigation fields are missing.
scenarios.matchedClause: deny contains msg if content incomplete

scenarios.name: Open critical finding still within SLA
scenarios.explanation: A tracked critical finding remains allowed while it is still within the 15-day remediation window.

scenarios.name: Critical finding past SLA without exception
scenarios.explanation: Critical flaws older than 15 days fail without remediation or an approved exception.
scenarios.matchedClause: deny contains msg if critical SLA exceeded

scenarios.name: Users, processes, and devices identified
scenarios.explanation: The inventory covers users, processes acting on their behalf, and devices.

scenarios.name: Users and devices without process inventory
scenarios.explanation: Identifying users and devices is insufficient when processes acting on behalf of users are missing.
scenarios.matchedClause: deny contains msg if processes not identified
